name: surface_dial
description: Use a Microsoft Surface Dial as a tactile Bluetooth controller for Volumio.
author: John Cann

volumio_info.details: Control Volumio playback and volume with a Microsoft Surface Dial over Bluetooth HID, including 50-step haptic volume control and automatic reconnect.
volumio_info.changelog: Adds hardware-validated 50-detent haptics, fixed 2% volume steps, unified haptics control, automatic Bluetooth reconnect, Volumio 4 UI fixes and submission-ready installer safeguards.
